notes: Park / T-US 2009 logistic-regression coefficient manifest. Three sets: park_2009_original (sourced from published paper), park_cosmos_validation (external validation refit), park_cohort_refit (this-cohort held-out GLM). NULL-default policy: when a primitive feature (composition, echogenicity, etc.) is NULL for a nodule, the corresponding binary X variable defaults to FALSE (absence-of-finding treated as negative). This is documented in the Phase B.6 README and the qc_phase_b6_park_x_completeness_v1 table.

park_2009_original.source: Park JY, Lee HJ, Jang HW, Kim HK, Yi JH, Lee W, Kim SH. A proposal for a thyroid imaging reporting and data system for ultrasound features of thyroid carcinoma. Thyroid. 2009;19(11):1257-1264. doi:10.1089/thy.2008.0021. PMID:19754280.
park_2009_original.source_note: Coefficients from Table 3 (multivariate logistic regression analysis) of the original paper. DO NOT FABRICATE — Logan must supply the exact β values from the paper PDF. Placeholder values below are marked __FILL__.
park_2009_original.coefficients_status: PENDING — awaiting Logan to supply from paper PDF

park_cosmos_validation.source: PENDING — Logan to cite the external validation paper. If a published refit cannot be located, source = 'park_2009_original' and notes updated accordingly.
park_cosmos_validation.source_note: External validation refit on a separate cohort. If no published validation with explicit β values is available, fallback = park_2009_original and this set is aliased. Document in README.

park_cohort_refit.source: This cohort (thyroid-canonical-pub-2026), 70/30 train/holdout, random_state=42, sklearn LogisticRegression(penalty='l2', C=1.0, solver='lbfgs', max_iter=1000). Train n=5079, test n=2178. Train AUC=0.6688, Test AUC=0.6611.
park_cohort_refit.source_note: Populated by 417b_park_cohort_refit.py after park_2009_original coefficients are filled. Trains on nodules with all 12 X non-null AND final-pathology label within ±90d of US exam.
